column1: # CCTypewriter deviations from the FM Abhaya layout (encodings/fm-abhaya.tsv in mooniak-font-tools).
# Each was checked by eye: glyph chart, the drawing next to its FM neighbours, and the same keys in FM Abhaya (2026-11-18). Same columns as the table.

column7: CCTypewriter draws the full ක්‍ෂ here (ක touching ෂ, 990 wide); FM has the touching first half ක්‍ (C+I = ක්‍ෂ) and ක්‍ෂ on Ë, which this Latin-1 font lacks. Visual
CCTypewriter draws the full ත්‍ව here (936 wide); FM has the touching first half ත්‍ (F+j = ත්‍ව). Visual
CCTypewriter draws the full න්‍ද here (න touching ද, with ද's tail); FM has the touching first half න්‍ and න්‍ද on ‡, which this font lacks. Visual
CCTypewriter swaps Ù and å: Ù has the nasal curl and cross-stroke of ඬ (~) with the joined al-lakuna. FM Abhaya draws ඞ් here. Visual
CCTypewriter swaps Ù and å: å has the body of ඞ (X), no nasal curl. FM Abhaya draws ඬ් here. Visual
A compact second ී (small loop and curl, overprinting the letter before it), as FM Abhaya also has on _ (Pandukabhaya has no _). Nothing reaches it: designer to decide where it is used
CCTypewriter draws a spacing g-like sign here, the shape of ෳ (diga gayanukitta), which the font otherwise lacks; Pandukabhaya has µ = roman i. Visual, medium confidence: designer to confirm
CCTypewriter: an unidentified letter-like glyph (a stem with a top loop and a bowl; near ශ / හ but neither). Kept typable on PUA U+E001; designer to identify. Pandukabhaya has ¶ = roman v
CCTypewriter: the designer's "Ceylon Calligraphy" logo in Sinhala script (1000 wide), like the Pushpa logo FM Abhaya has on Û. Kept typable on PUA U+E000; designer to decide
FM table composes ඦ from ` + P (ඡ), which draws nasal + ඡ; ඦ U+0DA6 sanyaka jayanna is nasal + ජ. Composed from `c instead (below). General FM correction, proposed for build_fm_abhaya.py
ඦ = nasal prefix + ජ (c). Replaces the table's `P
